crossRefs.note: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
“You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass…
Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
translations.bsb: “Now you, son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same land. And make a signpost where the road branches off to each city.
translations.kjv: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.
translations.asv: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come; they twain shall come forth out of one land: and mark out a place, mark it out at the head of the way to the city.
